sr.required: all policy metrics have complete finite anchor-cell scores and finite full-domain neighbor coverage

rr.required: all policy metrics have finite interior and boundary evidence with at least one interior edge and one boundary edge

boundary_conditioning.comparison_scope: fixed regime and facet context in the full cleaned domain

rr.aggregation: minimum_across_policy_metrics; normalized boundary drop must also be positive

fr_overall.STRONG: every supported facet is STRONG on similarity, coverage, and economics
fr_overall.ADEQUATE: every supported facet is at least MODERATE on similarity, coverage, and economics
fr_overall.DIVERGENT_VIABLE: coverage and economics are at least MODERATE for every supported facet, but at least one similarity band is LOW
fr_overall.ECONOMICALLY_WEAK: at least one supported facet has WEAK peer economics
fr_overall.MIXED: supported facet evidence does not fit another state
fr_overall.INSUFFICIENT: applicable facets exist but none is supported

profiles.BROAD_LOCAL_STRUCTURE_STRONG: SR is STRONG or MODERATE, RR is STRONG, and FR is STRONG, ADEQUATE, or N/A
profiles.REGIONALLY_COHERENT_LOCALLY_SENSITIVE: SR is SENSITIVE, RR is STRONG, and FR is not ECONOMICALLY_WEAK, MIXED, or INSUFFICIENT
profiles.LOCALLY_SMOOTH_REGIONALLY_WEAK: SR is STRONG or MODERATE, RR is WEAK, and FR is not ECONOMICALLY_WEAK, MIXED, or INSUFFICIENT
profiles.MIXED_AMBIGUOUS: sufficient evidence exists but the combination does not fit another profile
profiles.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: SR or RR is insufficient, or FR overall is INSUFFICIENT
